facts.about: The Company was established in 1981. A joint venture agreement was signed between the Government of India and Suzuki Motor Corporation (SMC), Japan in 1982. The Company became a subsidiary of SMC in 2002.It is the market leader in passenger vehicle segment in India. In terms of production volume and sales, the Company is now SMC’s largest subsidiary. SMC currently holds 56.28% of its equity stake. The principal activities of the Company are manufacturing, purchase and sale of motor vehicles, components and spare parts.

business.summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited is an automotive company engaged in the manufacturing and sale of passenger vehicles and related components. It generates revenue through the sale of vehicles, spare parts, and services in both domestic and international markets.

guidance.quote: The broad expectation, which our Chairman also conveyed, is growth of over 10% this year as compared to the last year.

narrative.scoreline: Management is delivering robust top-line growth but struggling to defend margins against the 'healthy trajectory' promised to investors.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Strong underlying demand is evidenced by 190,000 unserved customer orders.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Revenue grew 26% YoY in Sep 2026, supporting the claim of high demand.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: The company will return to a healthy margin trajectory.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Margins have compressed from 13% in FY25 to 8-9% in the first half of FY27.

bull: Revenue growth is accelerating, with Sep 2026 up 26% compared to a 16% three-year trend.
Exceptional cash generation with five-year operating cash flow reaching 118% of total net profit.
The balance sheet is practically debt-free with a net worth of ₹1.09 lakh crore.
bear: Operating margins have deteriorated significantly, dropping to 9% in Sep 2026 from 13% a year prior.
Net profit for Sep 2026 fell to ₹2,466 crore, the lowest level in over two years.
Significant capex of ₹14,000 crore is planned while margins are currently under pressure.
watch: Margin recovery in Q3 FY27 to validate the 'healthy trajectory' claim.

claims.claim: The company plans to increase production capacity to 4 million units per annum in the medium term.
claims.quote: Besides, the company has put plans in place to increase the production capacity to 4 million units per annum in the medium term.

claims.claim: The company has 190,000 unserved customer orders, highlighting strong underlying demand.
claims.quote: As of the end of the fiscal year, around 190,000 customer orders remained unserved, and we are trying to service them fast, highlighting the strength of the underlying demand.

claims.claim: The company expects to return to a healthy margin trajectory once geopolitical and commodity pressures subside.
claims.quote: We are very confident and optimistic that subject to these headwinds of the war, the commodities and the energy prices, after that is over, we'll come back to a healthy trajectory.
